These '''guard droids''' were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] blue-and-white military [[Droid/Legends|droids]] armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and quick reflexes. [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] used a group of these to defend his home in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
